description: OpenID Federation: trust chains, registration, hosted entities, Trust Marks, key history and the policy decision point. The codes are FederationEvents' constants; pf-integration emits most of them.

action.description: What the policy decision point was asked about: the action of the decision point (registration, token issuance, hosted-entity enrolment).

actor.description: Who made an administrative change: admin: and the first eight hex digits of the admin token's SHA-256, then the caller's own name for itself from X-Federation-Actor when it sent one - which can be a person's name or e-mail address.

changed.description: What an update changed: metadata or metadata_policy.

decision.description: The policy decision point's answer: permit or deny.

endpoint.description: Where it happened: the registration endpoint, the token endpoint, a front-channel endpoint, or a federation endpoint's name.

enforcement.description: What OIDF_REGISTRATION_EXPIRY_ENFORCEMENT said to do with an expired registration.

entity_type.description: The Entity Type the client registered as (openid_relying_party, oauth_client).

exp.description: When a signed statement or a retired key expires, in seconds since the epoch.

expires_at.description: When a registration ends, in seconds since the epoch.

ignored_context.description: The request-context keys the policy decision point said it ignored.

keys_changed.description: Whether a refreshed registration's keys differ from the ones it replaced.

kid.description: The key id of one of this PingFederate's own signing keys.

latency_ms.description: How long the policy decision point took to answer, in milliseconds.

listable.description: Whether an enrolled hosted entity is listed at the list endpoint.

missing_trust_marks.description: The Trust Mark types a registration lacked.

new_kid.description: The key id of the signing key that replaced a retired one.

not_after.description: When a Trust Mark grant ends, in seconds since the epoch.

obligation.description: The permit's obligation a token did not meet: scope, grant_types or require_trust_mark.

obligations.description: The obligations a permit carried, by name.

pdp_request_id.description: The policy decision point's own id for the request, for finding it in its logs.

presented.description: How many statements the presented trust chain held.

previous_expires_at.description: When the registration a refresh replaced would have ended, in seconds since the epoch.

reason.description: Why a retired key was revoked: unspecified, compromised or superseded.

trust_anchor.description: The Entity Identifier of the trust anchor a Trust Mark was checked against.

type.description: How the client registered: explicit or automatic.

federation.chain.validated.description: The OGNL criterion checked a client's trust chain at token issuance and it validated.

federation.chain.refused.description: The OGNL criterion checked a client's trust chain at token issuance and refused it; reason says why.

federation.constraints.failed.description: A trust chain broke a Subordinate Statement's constraints. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.policy.applied.description: A trust chain's metadata policy was applied to a leaf's metadata. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.policy.conflict.description: Two metadata policies in a trust chain could not be combined. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.statement.served.description: An Entity Configuration or Subordinate Statement was served. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.request.refused.description: A request to a federation endpoint was refused. Declared; nothing emits it yet - a refusal at a federation endpoint is a FederationErrors log line.

federation.resolve.served.description: The resolve endpoint answered. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.resolve.refused.description: The resolve endpoint refused a request. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.hosted_entity.enrolled.description: A hosted agent was enrolled, and by whom.

federation.hosted_entity.suspended.description: A hosted agent was suspended, and by whom; the description is the reason given.

federation.hosted_entity.reactivated.description: A suspended hosted agent was reactivated, and by whom.

federation.hosted_entity.revoked.description: A hosted agent was revoked, permanently, and by whom.

federation.hosted_entity.rotated.description: A hosted agent was moved to another hosting key, and by whom.

federation.hosted_entity.updated.description: A hosted agent's metadata or metadata policy was changed, and by whom.

federation.hosted_entity.resolved.description: A hosted agent's statement was resolved. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.hosted_entity.refused.description: The policy decision point refused an enrolment.

federation.registration.created.description: A client was registered - explicit or automatic, at which endpoint, and until when.

federation.registration.refreshed.description: A registration was renewed or replaced, until when, and whether its keys changed.

federation.registration.refused.description: A registration was refused: the chain, a missing metadata policy, a missing Trust Mark, the policy decision point, or PingFederate dropping the extended properties.

federation.registration.expired.description: A request found a registration past its end and not renewed; what happened next follows OIDF_REGISTRATION_EXPIRY_ENFORCEMENT.

federation.registration.expired_at_issua.description: The OGNL criterion found an expired registration at token issuance.

federation.registration.refresh_deferred.description: A due renewal failed but the registration has not expired, so it stands for now.

federation.registration.disabled.description: An expired client was disabled, by the request that found it or by the sweeper.

federation.trust_mark.granted.description: A Trust Mark grant was made, until when, and by whom.

federation.trust_mark.refused.description: A Trust Mark was refused. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.trust_mark.revoked.description: A Trust Mark grant was revoked, and by whom; the description is the reason given.

federation.trust_mark.verified.description: Another issuer's Trust Mark checked out.

federation.pdp.consulted.description: The policy decision point answered (read decision), or gave no answer (reason no_decision).

federation.token.refused.description: Token issuance was refused by the policy decision point, or for an obligation the token does not meet.

federation.pdp.failopen.description: The policy decision point gave no answer and OIDF_PDP_FAIL_OPEN=true let the request through.

federation.anchor.loaded.description: A trust anchor's keys were loaded. Declared; nothing emits it yet.

federation.fetch.made.description: A statement was fetched from another entity. Declared; nothing emits it yet. Chatty, so written at DEBUG.

federation.key.retired.description: PingFederate's signing key changed since it last started: the old key was retired.

federation.key.revoked.description: A retired signing key was revoked, why, and by whom.

federation.client.authenticated.description: A client authenticated at a federation endpoint.

federation.client.refused.description: A client was refused at a federation endpoint.

attestation.client.verified.description: A client's attestation was verified: by the token-endpoint filter, or by the OGNL issuance criterion (its own verification, or the filter's reused under the same policy). The subject is the client, the partner its attester.

attestation.client.refused.description: A client's attestation was refused, or a client that authenticates only with one sent none, by the token-endpoint filter or the OGNL issuance criterion. The reason is the OAuth error the filter answers with (the criterion's refusal is PingFederate's configured Error Result).
